fullPassage: For many people, ability refers to intellectual competence, so they want everything they do to reflect how smart they are — writing a brilliant legal brief, getting the highest grade on a test, writing elegant computer code, saying something exceptionally wise or witty in a conversation. You could also define ability in terms of a particular skill or talent, such as how well one plays the piano, learns a language, or serves a tennis ball. Some people focus on their ability to be attractive, entertaining, up on the latest trends, or to have the newest gadgets. However ability may be defined, a problem occurs when it is the sole determinant of one's self-worth. The performance becomes the only measure of the person; nothing else is taken into account. An outstanding performance means an outstanding person; an average performance means an average person. Period.

det.analysis:
밑줄 친 'Period.'는 문장 끝에 홀로 쓰여 '더 말할 것도 없다, 그것으로 끝'이라는 뜻의 관용 표현이에요. 즉 '수행이 곧 그 사람'이라는 판단에 예외나 다른 고려가 전혀 없다는 단호함을 나타내요.

① People need regular rest between difficult tasks(어려운 일 사이에 휴식이 필요하다): 휴식과 무관해요.

② Every performance can be improved with more time(모든 수행은 시간이 지나면 나아진다): 향상 가능성을 말하는 글이 아니에요.

③ Time is divided into equal and fixed stages(시간은 균등한 단계로 나뉜다): period를 '기간'으로 잘못 해석한 것이에요.

④ The judgment is final and allows no other factors(그 판단은 확정적이며 다른 요인을 허용하지 않는다): nothing else is taken into account와 통하는 단호한 결론 ←정답
det.tip: 문장 끝의 'Period.' = '(더 말할 것 없이) 그것으로 끝'이라는 관용 표현

questions.passage: For many people, ability refers to intellectual competence, so they want everything they do to reflect how smart they are — writing a brilliant legal brief, getting the highest grade on a test, writing elegant computer code, saying something exceptionally wise or witty in a conversation. You could also define ability in terms of a particular skill or talent, such as how well one plays the piano, learns a language, or serves a tennis ball. Some people focus on their ability to be attractive, entertaining, up on the latest trends, or to have the newest gadgets. However ability may be defined, a problem occurs when <u>it</u> is the sole determinant of one's self-worth. The performance becomes the only measure of the person; nothing else is taken into account. An outstanding performance means an outstanding person; an average performance means an average person. Period.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 it이 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 능력(ability)
det.analysis:
밑줄 친 부분은 'However ability may be defined, a problem occurs when it is the sole determinant of one's self-worth'예요. '그것(it)이 자존감의 유일한 결정 요인이 될 때'에서, 자존감의 결정 요인이 될 수 있는 것은 문장 첫머리의 '능력(ability)'이에요.

② 문제(a problem)는 발생하는 결과일 뿐 결정 요인이 아니에요.

③ 수행(the performance)은 다음 문장에서 등장해요.

④ 자존감(self-worth)은 it이 영향을 미치는 대상이지 it 자체가 아니에요.
det.tip: it = ability. 능력이 자존감의 유일한 결정 요인이 될 때 문제가 생긴다

det.korean: a particular skill or talent (특정한 기술이나 재능)

③ an inherited social status(물려받은 사회적 지위): 지위와 무관해요.

④ a strict moral rule(엄격한 도덕 규칙): 규칙에 관한 내용이 아니에요.
